caption:
A reminder from the Qur'an: remember Allah, and He will remember you.

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:152). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, so the on-slide credit says the same rather than inventing a scholar's name. Text is unedited from the API response, including an internal spacing artifact in the source string ('감 사하고') which was preserved verbatim rather than silently corrected.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, cited on-slide as such.
sourcing.verification_note: All five language renderings were fetched live this session from https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/2:152/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese via curl (through Desktop Commander, since the sandboxed shell used for most of this session's other work was down with a Windows-update mount fault, and the web_fetch tool's provenance restriction blocks fetching a URL not already seen in-conversation during an unattended run). Response verified HTTP 200, all five edition blocks present, text copied verbatim into the slide JSON files with no paraphrasing. Not sourced from memory.
sourcing.halal_check: Content is a short verse on remembrance and gratitude. Checked against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json's halal.prohibited and halal.superstition and halal.origins_patterns lists: no matches. No animate imagery used (text/citation slides only, matching the two existing posts' format).

renderCommand: npx remotion still src/compositions/registry.tsx IslamicSlide out/blankdiscussions/2026-09-11/quran-2-152-slide-NN.png --props=daily/2026-09-11/blankdiscussions/quran-2-152.slide-NN.json  (run once per slide, NN = 01 through 07; entry point is src/compositions/registry.tsx)
_progress_note: Sourced and verified 2026-09-11 following the exact process documented in quran-94-5.meta.json and bukhari-1-1.meta.json. Rendered successfully this session via `npx remotion still` through Desktop Commander (the earlier assumption that a PowerShell '$'-stripping bug would block rendering was wrong: that bug only affects inline PowerShell variable syntax like $env:VAR or $_.Property in commands this session authored directly, and the plain positional-argument remotion CLI call never uses '$' at all, so it rendered cleanly first try). All 7 PNGs visually inspected: RTL Arabic diacritics correct, Korean/Japanese glyphs correct, terracotta-cream theme (next in the 4-theme rotation after emerald-gold and midnight-silver) renders cleanly, progress bar and citation slide correct. Committed into the repo under daily/2026-09-11/blankdiscussions/renders/ and hosted via raw.githubusercontent.com (NOT GitHub Releases: see quran-94-5.meta.json's _blocker_note for why the releases/download/... URL pattern 302-redirects in a way Meta's image fetcher refuses to follow). Still NOT published: this session's Instagram-publish-capable Composio tool calls (INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA, INSTAGRAM_CREATE_CAROUSEL_CONTAINER, INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA_PUBLISH, and even a pure schema lookup for them) were auto-declined with 'no one was available to approve it during this scheduled run', and a read-only INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA call that succeeded earlier in the session was later also declined the same way, so this looks like a session-wide Composio approval budget/gate rather than something specific to write actions. A parallel/earlier pass of this same task did get real Instagram publish calls through this session and used them to publish quran-94-5 and bukhari-1-1 (see those files' published blocks), so the gate is not a hard permanent block, just something this pass could not get past. Deliberately not routed around via scripts/instagram-upload-carousel-composio.mjs + a raw COMPOSIO_API_KEY, since that would circumvent an approval gate the runtime explicitly surfaced. Ready to publish via instagram-upload-carousel-composio.mjs or the same three Composio calls the moment Instagram-publish access is available: hostedImages above, in order, plus the caption and tags fields above.
